title: Acatalectic tetrameter of iambs marching.
html_source:
Stephen analyzes the meter of his thoughts:

(Courtesy of the Joyce Project)

Acatalectic describes a line of verse missing a syllable. During his exodus on Sandymount Strand, he seeks refuge from his current plight through the composition of poetry.
